implementation_choices: Size rule: the median needs at least half of the 24 look-back months available; format-wide missing months are skipped and zero months count as zero.
A month with fewer rows than the SPL API count is a partial download and is treated as missing.
Donor overlap counts a category's works per format over all months of data.
Donors must also pass the minimum-size rule at that window and format.
Donor and placebo-year shift screens use shifts from both sources and of every class, seasonal included.
A donor missing any month in which the treated category is observed is left out of the pool.
Demeaning uses the same available months for every unit (months where the treated category is observed).

Fits need at least 75% of their window's months (event study 18 of 24, synthetic control 17 of 22, tone baseline and shift weeks); a calendar month never seen in the event-study fit gets no prediction.
Smallest donor pool: 2 (the report shows the smallest possible p, 1 / (donors + 1)).
One-sided rank p-value: units are ranked by sign(effect) x post/pre RMSPE, with post RMSPE over the effect window being tested; ties count against the treated category.
Placebo years: "no shift in that window" uses months -6 to +6; the placebo window must pass the size rule; the comparison uses the primary window.
Event-study placebo categories are the synthetic control's donors.
Month 0 is the month of the shift week's Monday.

Positive controls pass with a positive synthetic-control effect (months 0 to +2) and one-sided p < 0.05 in at least one Seattle format; LibriVox is shown but does not decide; the title-word backup keeps the main overlap table and only reports a pass when the main assignment did not pass.
Power: the same placebo draws for every lift size, drawn without replacement.
Benjamini-Hochberg family: all main-analysis shift x format tests, primary window; seasonal shifts are a separate family. Pooled means by source x level x format, source x level, and duration class.
Bootstrap intervals are 95% percentile intervals; bootstrap p-values are descriptive.
Carry-over model fitted per source and level, main-analysis shifts only; format dummies are among Seattle formats, LibriVox enters through the classic indicator.

Tone: each feature in its own model; two-sided placebo p (share of |placebo coef| >= |real coef|); a shift blocks max(duration, 4) weeks for placebo windows; baseline excludes the start week; placebo windows use the bootstrap seed and are drawn without replacement when enough exist.
LibriVox: every month with views is complete; the size rule uses recordings as works and views as checkouts.
Shifts without a record duration class (`interrupted`, `censored`) are not tested; they count in the shift screens.
Interest adapter: a shift with no seasonal verdict is not seasonal; partial GDELT weeks are missing for tone.
